title: Shifokor va dorixona
goal_uz: Dars oxirida siz inglizcha simptomlaringizni aniq ta’riflagansiz — og‘riq turi, davomiyligi va kuchi; shifokor ko‘rsatmalarini va doza so‘zlarini tushunasiz; qabulga yozilasiz; dorixona suhbatida savol berasiz va javob olasiz.
homework_uz: Shifokor bilan dialog yozing: uchta simptomni aniq ta’riflang (og‘riq turi, davomiyligi, kuchi), shifokorning ikki doza ko‘rsatmasini yozib oling va bitta allergiya haqida ayting. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: dialog inglizchada, har simptom aniq, vaqti ko‘rsatilgan ('for three days', 'since Monday') va ovoz chiqarib o‘qilganda ikki daqiqadan oshmaydi. Keyingi dars: P1-12 Bank, pul va hujjatlar.

vocab.uz: simptom — og‘riq, isitma, yo‘tal kabi belgi
tomoq og‘rig‘i ('I have a sore throat')
bosh og‘rig‘i — 'I have a headache' deb aytiladi
1 dan 10 gacha shkala — og‘riq kuchini aytish
'since Monday' — boshlangan sana; 'for three days' — davomiylik
alergiyasi bor ('Are you allergic to anything?')

scenes.title: Shifokor darsiga xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! O‘tgan darsda sayohat inglizchasini — aeroport, mehmonxona, shikoyat va refundni — o‘rgandik. Bugun esa salomatlik: shifokorga simptomlaringizni aniq ta’riflash, og‘riq vaqti va kuchini aytish, dorixona ko‘rsatmalarini tushunish va qabulga yozilish. Dars oxirida siz inglizcha shifokorga borib, gapingizni aniq tushintirasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome! Last lesson was travel English. Today: doctor and pharmacy — describing symptoms precisely, saying how long and how strong, understanding dosage instructions, and booking an appointment. By the end, you'll handle a doctor's visit in English.
scenes.say_uz: Assalomu alaykum! O‘tgan darsda sayohat inglizchasi — aeroport, mehmonxona, refundni o‘rgandik. Bugun: shifokor va dorixona — simptomlarni aniq ta’riflash, davomiyligi va kuchini aytish, doza ko‘rsatmalarini tushunish va qabulga yozilish. Dars oxirida siz shifokorga bemalol borasiz.

scenes.title: Shifokor bilan — 4 ko‘nikma
scenes.say_native: Shifokor qabuli to‘rtta asosiy qismdan iborat. Bir: simptomlar — nima bezovta qiladi: og‘riq, isitma, yo‘tal. Ikki: davomiyligi va kuchi — qanchadan beri va qancha kuchli. Uch: ko‘rsatmalar va doza — dorini qachon, qanchadan va qancha vaqt ichish. To‘rt: qabulga yozilish — resepsiyon yoki telefon orqali. Bugungi darsda har birini alohida ishlaymiz.
scenes.say: A doctor's visit has four parts. One: symptoms — what bothers you. Two: duration and intensity — how long and how bad. Three: instructions and dosage — when, how much and how often to take the medicine. Four: booking the appointment. We'll work through each one today.
scenes.say_uz: Shifokor qabuli to‘rt qismdan iborat. Bir: simptomlar — nima bezovta qiladi. Ikki: davomiyligi va kuchi — qanchadan beri, qancha kuchli. Uch: ko‘rsatma va doza — qachon, qanchadan, qancha vaqt. To‘rt: qabulga yozilish. Har birini birma-bir ishlaymiz.

scenes.title: Tana a’zolari: asosiy lug‘at

examples.t: I have a sharp pain in my lower back.

scenes.say_native: Tana a’zolarini inglizchada aniq bilishingiz kerak: bosh — head, tomoq — throat, ko‘krak — chest, oshqozon — stomach, bel — back, qo‘l — arm va hand, oyoq — leg va foot, tizza — knee, bo‘g‘im — joint, muskul — muscle. Ikki ibora yetadi: 'My back hurts' — belim og‘riyapti; 'I have a pain in my chest' — ko‘kragimda og‘riq. Joyni aniq ayting: upper — yuqori, lower — pastki, left — chap, right — o‘ng.
scenes.say: Learn the body parts precisely: head, throat, chest, stomach, back, arm, hand, leg, foot, knee, joint, muscle. Two patterns cover most cases: 'My back hurts' — general ache; 'I have a pain in my chest' — localised. Add upper, lower, left, right to be precise.
scenes.say_uz: Tana a’zolarini aniq yodlang: head, throat, chest, stomach, back, arm, hand, leg, foot, knee, joint, muscle. Ikki shakl yetadi: 'My back hurts' — belim og‘riyapti; 'I have a pain in my chest' — ko‘kragimda og‘riq. Aniqlik uchun: upper, lower, left, right.

scenes.title: Ache vs pain va og‘riq sifatlari
board: pain: a sharp / dull / stabbing pain

examples.t: I have a throbbing headache since this morning.
examples.uz: Ertalabdan beri urib og‘riydigan bosh og‘rig‘im bor.

scenes.say_native: Ikki so‘z bir-biridan farq qiladi. 'Ache' — doimiy, siqilishli og‘riq va qo‘shma otlarda ishlatiladi: headache, toothache, stomachache, earache, backache. 'Pain' — o‘tkirroq og‘riq va sifat bilan keladi: 'a sharp pain', 'a dull pain', 'a stabbing pain' — sanchish, 'a throbbing pain' — urib og‘rish, 'a burning pain' — yondiruvchi. 'Sore' — shishgan yoki qizargan a’zo: 'a sore throat', 'sore eyes'. Sifatni qo‘shing — shifokor aniqroq tushunadi.
scenes.say: Two different words. 'Ache' is a steady, pressing pain and forms compounds: headache, toothache, stomachache, earache, backache. 'Pain' pairs with adjectives: sharp, dull, stabbing, throbbing, burning. 'Sore' means inflamed: a sore throat, sore eyes. Add an adjective — the doctor understands you faster.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki xil so‘z. 'Ache' — doimiy og‘riq, qo‘shma otlar: headache, toothache, stomachache, earache, backache. 'Pain' sifatlar bilan: sharp, dull, stabbing, throbbing, burning. 'Sore' — yallig‘langan: a sore throat, sore eyes. Sifat qo‘shing — shifokor tezroq tushunadi.

scenes.title: Simptomlar lug‘ati: yo‘taldan boshlanib

examples.t: I've had a fever of 38 degrees since last night.

scenes.say_native: Simptom so‘zlarini yodlang: cough — yo‘tal, fever — isitma, rash — toshma, nausea — ko‘ngil aynishi, dizziness — bosh aylanishi, shortness of breath — nafas qisishi, vomiting — qayt qilish, diarrhea — ich ketishi, fatigue — charchoq. Inglizchada simptomlar odatda 'I have a…' yoki 'I've been feeling…' bilan: 'I've been coughing for a week', 'I feel dizzy when I stand up'.
scenes.say: Symptom vocabulary: cough, fever, rash, nausea, dizziness, shortness of breath, vomiting, diarrhea, fatigue. Patterns: 'I have a fever of thirty-eight' or 'I've been coughing for a week' or 'I feel dizzy when I stand up'.
scenes.say_uz: Simptomlar: cough, fever, rash, nausea, dizziness, shortness of breath, vomiting, diarrhea, fatigue. Shakllar: 'I have a fever of thirty-eight', 'I've been coughing for a week', 'I feel dizzy when I stand up'.

scenes.title: Namuna: simptomni ta’riflash
scenes.say_native: Namuna ta’rifni o‘qing va tuzilmani ajrating: simptom nomi, qachondan beri, qancha kuchli — uch qator, to‘liq rasm. E’tibor bering — 'since last night' boshlanish nuqtasi, 'on a scale of one to ten' — kuch; parasetamol ichgani va yordam bermagani ham aytilgan.
scenes.say: Doctor, I have a sore throat and a throbbing headache. It started last night — since then the pain has been constant. Swallowing hurts. On a scale of one to ten, the throat is about six, and I also feel achy and tired. I've taken paracetamol, but it hasn't helped much.
scenes.say_uz: Doktor, tomog‘im og‘riyapti va boshim urib og‘riyapti. Kecha kechasi boshlangan — shundan beri og‘riq doimiy. Yutinish og‘riyapti. Bir dan o‘n gacha shkala bo‘yicha tomoq — taxminan olti, va o‘zimni og‘riqli va charchagan his qilaman. Parasetamol ichdim, lekin ko‘p yordam bermadi.

scenes.title: Symptomni ta’riflang
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz simptomni ta’riflang. Vaziyat: ikki kundan beri boshingiz og‘riyapti, ertalab yomonroq, bir dan o‘n gacha — yetti ball. 'I have a…' bilan boshlang, 'for two days' deb davomiylikni ayting, 'on a scale of one to ten' bilan kuchini bildiring. Yigirma soniya.
scenes.say: Describe the symptom. Scenario: headache for two days, worse in the morning, seven out of ten. Start with 'I have a…', add 'for two days', rate it 'on a scale of one to ten'. Twenty seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Simptomni ta’riflang. Ikki kundan beri bosh og‘rig‘i, ertalab yomonroq, o‘ndan yetti. 'I have a…' bilan boshlang, 'for two days' va 'on a scale of one to ten' qo‘shing. Yigirma soniya.

scenes.title: Duration: since yoki for?

examples.t: It started yesterday and has been constant since then.
examples.uz: Kecha boshlangan va shundan beri doimiy.

scenes.say_native: Since va for — eng ahamiyatli ikki so‘z. 'Since' — boshlangan nuqtani aytadi: 'since Monday', 'since last night', 'since I woke up'. 'For' — davriylik: 'for two days', 'for a week', 'for three months'. 'It started yesterday' — oddiy vaqtni aytish. Xatoni oldini olish uchun eslang: since + nuqta, for + davr. O‘zbekcha 'dan beri' ikkalasiga ham o‘xshaydi, shuning uchun chalkashlik — ikkalasini ham inglizchada ishlatib o‘rganing.
scenes.say: Since and for — the two key words. 'Since' points to the start: since Monday, since last night, since I woke up. 'For' measures the period: for two days, for a week, for three months. Rule: since + point in time, for + length of time.
scenes.say_uz: Since va for — ikki asosiy so‘z. 'Since' — boshlanish nuqtasi: since Monday, since last night, since I woke up. 'For' — davr: for two days, for a week. Qoida: since + nuqta, for + davr.

scenes.title: Intensity: og‘riq kuchi 1 dan 10 gacha
board: 'On a scale of 1 to 10, it's a seven.'

examples.t: On a scale of one to ten, I'd say it's about a six.
examples.uz: Bir dan o‘n gacha — menimcha, taxminan olti.

scenes.say_native: Og‘riq kuchini uchma uchta so‘z bilan aytasiz: mild — yengil, moderate — o‘rtacha, severe — kuchli. Lekin shifokorlar ko‘proq 1 dan 10 gacha shkalani ishlatadi: 'On a scale of one to ten, it's about a six'. Bir — deyarli his qilinmaydi, o‘n — chidab bo‘lmas. Raqam aytishingiz bilan shifokor shoshilinch ekanligini va davolash yo‘lini aniqlaydi — so‘zlaringiz aniq bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: Rate pain with three words — mild, moderate, severe — or better, the one-to-ten scale doctors use: 'On a scale of one to ten, I'd say it's about a six.' One is barely there; ten is unbearable. A number tells the doctor how urgent this is.
scenes.say_uz: Og‘riqni uch so‘z bilan: mild, moderate, severe — yoki yaxshiroq, shifokorlar ishlatadigan 1-10 shkala: 'On a scale of one to ten, I'd say it's about a six.' Bir — deyarli yo‘q; o‘n — chidab bo‘lmas. Raqam — shoshilinchlikni ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Frequency: qanchalik tez-tez

examples.t: The pain comes and goes — worse at night.

scenes.say_native: Chastota iboralari: 'all the time' — doimiy, 'most of the day' — kunning ko‘p qismi, 'now and then' — ba’zan-ba’zan, 'comes and goes' — kelib-ketadi, 'worse at night' — kechasi kuchliroq, 'after meals' — ovqatdan keyin, 'when I move' — harakatda. Shifokorga chaqstota juda muhim: doimiy og‘riq boshqa taktikani, kelib-ketuvchi — boshqa taktikani talab qiladi.
scenes.say: Frequency phrases: 'all the time' — constant; 'most of the day'; 'now and then' — occasional; 'comes and goes'; 'worse at night'; 'after meals'; 'when I move'. Frequency changes the diagnosis — constant and intermittent pain need different approaches.
scenes.say_uz: Chastota iboralari: 'all the time' — doimiy; 'most of the day'; 'now and then' — ba’zan; 'comes and goes' — kelib-ketadi; 'worse at night' — kechasi; 'after meals' — ovqatdan keyin. Chastota tashxisni o‘zgartiradi.

scenes.title: Tinglash 1: shifokorda qabul
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash — klinika qabuli. Malika isitma va tomoq og‘rig‘i bilan keldi. Shifokor simptom, davomiylik, kuch va allergiya haqida so‘raydi; Malika har biriga aniq javob beradi. Diqqat bilan tinglang va har bir raqamni esda tuting — keyingi sahifada to‘rtta savol bor.
scenes.say: Doctor: What brings you in? Malika: A fever and a sore throat since yesterday — 38 degrees last night. Doctor: Pain on a scale of one to ten? Malika: The throat is about seven when I swallow. Headache maybe a four. Doctor: Any cough? Malika: A dry cough, yes. Any allergies? None. Doctor: Rest, fluids, and paracetamol every six hours if needed. I'll write a note for work.
scenes.say_uz: Shifokor: Xayrli tong. Nima bezovta qilmoqda? Malika: Xayrli tong, doktor. Kemadan beri isitmam va tomog‘im og‘riyapti. Kecha kechasi haroratim o‘ttiz sakkiz daraja edi. Shifokor: Og‘riq bir dan o‘n gacha? Malika: Tomoq — yutinaganda yetti atrofida. Bosh og‘rig‘i — balki to‘rt. Shifokor: Yo‘tal yoki burun oqishi bormi? Malika: Quruq yo‘tal bor. Burun oqishi yo‘q. Shifokor: Allergiyangiz bormi? Malika: Yo‘q, bilganimcha yo‘q. Shifokor: Dam oling, suyuqlik iching, kerak bo‘lsa olti soatda bir parasetamol. Ishga ma’lumotnoma yozib beraman.

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari 1
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savol. Bir: Malika qachondan beri simptomlari bor? Ikki: kecha kechasi harorati qancha daraja edi? Uch: tomoq og‘rig‘i shkalada necha ball — va qachon kuchayadi? To‘rt: shifokor nima tavsiya qildi — uchta narsani ayting. Javoblarni ichingizda ayting.
scenes.say: Four questions. One: since when has Malika had symptoms? Two: what was her temperature last night? Three: how severe is the throat pain on the scale? Four: what did the doctor recommend — name three things. Answers in your head.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt savol. Bir: qachondan beri simptomlar? Ikki: harorati qancha edi? Uch: tomoq og‘rig‘i necha ball? To‘rt: shifokor nima tavsiya qildi — uch narsa. Javoblarni ichingizda ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tinglash 1
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: simptomlar kemadan beri — 'since yesterday'. Ikki: o‘ttiz sakkiz daraja. Uch: tomoq — yutinaganda yetti atrofida. To‘rt: dam oling, ko‘p suyuqlik iching va kerak bo‘lganda olti soatda bir parasetamol; shuningdek, ishga ma’lumotnoma yozib beradi. Malika allergiyasi yo‘qligini ham aytdi — shifokor har doim shuni so‘raydi.
scenes.say: Answers. One: since yesterday. Two: thirty-eight degrees. Three: about seven when swallowing. Four: rest, plenty of fluids, paracetamol every six hours if needed — plus a doctor's note for work. She also confirmed no allergies — always be ready for that question.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Bir: kemadan beri. Ikki: o‘ttiz sakkiz daraja. Uch: yutinaganda taxminan yetti. To‘rt: dam, suyuqlik, har olti soatda parasetamol — va ishga ma’lumotnoma. Allergiyasi yo‘qligini aytdi.

scenes.title: Qabulga yozilish: appointment

examples.t: I'd like to make an appointment with Dr Karimov, please.

scenes.say_native: Qabulga yozilishning to‘g‘ri shakli: 'I'd like to make an appointment' — muloyim va standart. Tez yordam kerakligini bildirish uchun: 'as soon as possible' yoki 'it's urgent'. Resepsion sizdan ismingizni, tug‘ilgan sanangizni va muammongizni qisqacha so‘raydi: man about a sore throat for two days' — ikki kunlik tomoq og‘rig‘i. 'Which doctor?' — mutaxassisingizni ayting yoki 'any GP' — ixtiyoriy shifokor. Vaqt taklifini eshitib, rozi bo‘ling yoki muqobil so‘rang: 'Could I come at 11 instead?'
scenes.say: Booking an appointment: 'I'd like to make an appointment.' Need it fast? Add 'as soon as possible' or 'it's urgent'. Reception will ask your name, your date of birth and a brief reason — 'a sore throat for two days'. 'Which doctor?' — name your GP or say 'any doctor is fine'. If the slot doesn't suit, ask: 'Could I come at eleven instead?'
scenes.say_uz: Qabulga yozilish: 'I'd like to make an appointment.' Shoshilinch? 'As soon as possible' yoki 'it's urgent' qo‘shing. Resepsion ism, tug‘ilgan sana va qisqa sabab so‘raydi — 'a sore throat for two days'. 'Which doctor?' — GP yoki 'any doctor is fine'. Vaqt mos kelmasa: 'Could I come at eleven instead?'

scenes.title: Namuna: telefonda qabulga yozilish
scenes.say_native: Namuna telefon yozuvini o‘qing: mijoz maqsadini aytadi, simptomini bir jumlada tushuntiradi, taklif qilingan vaqtni qabul qiladi va salom bilan tugatadi. E’tibor bering — mijoz hisobini ataylab qisqa aytdi; tafsilotlar qabulda aytiladi, resepsiyonda emas — resepsion uzoq suhbatni yoqtirmaydi.
scenes.say: Good morning, City Clinic. Good morning — I'd like to make an appointment with Dr Karimov, please. Reception: Is it urgent? I've had a sore throat and fever since yesterday. Reception: I can offer tomorrow at 09:20. That works — and could I come at 09:00? Reception: 09:10 is the earliest. Fine. Reception: And your name and date of birth? Dilobar Rahimova, born 12 May 1990. Reception: All set, see you tomorrow.
scenes.say_uz: Xayrli tong, City Clinic. Xayrli tong — Dr Karimovimga qabulga yozilmoqchiman, iltimos. Resepsion: Shoshilinchmi? Kemadan beri tomog‘im og‘riyapti, isitmam bor. Resepsion: Ertaga 09:20ga joyni taklif qila olaman. Mos keladi — 09:00ga bora olamanmi? Resepsion: Eng erta 09:10. Yaxshi. Resepsion: Ismingiz va tug‘ilgan sanangiz? Dilobar Rahimova, 1990-yil 12-mayda tug‘ilganman. Resepsion: Tayyor, ertaga ko‘rishguncha.

scenes.title: Doza so‘zlari: mg, ml, tablet, drops

examples.t: Take one tablet of 500 milligrams twice a day.
examples.uz: Kuniga ikki marta 500 milligramli bittadan tablet iching.

scenes.say_native: Doza so‘zlarini aniq biling: tablet — tabletka, capsule — kapsula, syrup — sirop, drops — tomchilar, ointment — surtma, injection — ukol. O‘lchovlar: milligrams — mg, millilitres — ml, 'a teaspoon' — 5 ml, 'one tablet three times a day' — kuniga uch marta bittadan. Shifokor yozganini ovoz chiqarib takrorlang: 'One tablet twice a day' — shubha bo‘lsa, qayta so‘rang — dozadagi xato eng xavfli xato.
scenes.say: Dose vocabulary: tablet, capsule, syrup, drops, ointment, injection. Measures: milligrams, millilitres, a teaspoon — five millilitres — twice or three times a day. Repeat the dose aloud: 'One tablet twice a day.' If unsure, ask again — dose errors are the dangerous ones.
scenes.say_uz: Doza: tablet, capsule, syrup, drops, ointment, injection. O‘lchovlar: milligrams, millilitres, teaspoon — besh ml — twice/three times a day. Dozani ovoz chiqarib takrorlang: 'One tablet twice a day.' Shubha bo‘lsa, qayta so‘rang.

scenes.title: Kno‘rsatmalar: qachon va qanday

examples.t: Take it after meals, and finish the full course.
examples.uz: Ovqatdan keyin iching va to‘liq kursni tugating.

scenes.say_native: Ko‘rsatmalar standart, lekin so‘zlari yangi: 'twice a day' — kuniga ikki marta, 'three times a day' — uch marta, 'every six hours' — har olti soatda, 'with food' / 'after meals' — ovqat bilan yoki keyin, 'on an empty stomach' — och qoringa, 'before bed' — yotishdan oldin, 'finish the full course' — kursni to‘liq tugatish — antibiotiklarda eng muhim qoida. Asosiy qoida: yaxshilanib qolsangiz ham, shifokor aytgan kunda to‘xtating — o‘zingiz to‘xtatmang.
scenes.say: Instructions are standard but the words matter: 'twice a day', 'every six hours', 'with food' or 'after meals', 'on an empty stomach', 'before bed', 'finish the full course' — the last one especially for antibiotics. Even if you feel better, stop only when the doctor said.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘rsatmalar standart, so‘zlari muhim: 'twice a day', 'every six hours', 'with food'/'after meals', 'on an empty stomach', 'before bed', 'finish the full course' — antibiotiklarda ayniqsa muhim. Yaxshilansangiz ham, shifokor aytguncha to‘xtatmang.

scenes.title: Dorixona: retseptsiz yoki retsept bilan

examples.t: Do I need a prescription for this, or is it over the counter?

scenes.say_native: Dorixonada ikki turdagi dori bor: retseptsiz — over the counter, o‘zingiz olasiz; retsept bilan — prescription, faqat shifokor yozgan qog‘oz bilan. Farmatsevt — pharmacist — juda yordam beradi: u sizga doza va nomofini aytib beradi. Savol: 'Do I need a prescription for this?' — retsept kerakmi? 'Can I take this with other medicine?' — boshqa dorilar bilan mumkinmi? 'Are there any side effects?' — nojo‘ya ta’sirlari bormi?
scenes.say: Two kinds of medicine: over the counter — you can buy it yourself; prescription-only — you need the doctor's note. The pharmacist can help a lot. Ask: 'Do I need a prescription for this?' 'Can I take this with other medicine?' 'Are there any side effects?'
scenes.say_uz: Ikki turdagi dori: over the counter — retseptsiz; prescription-only — faqat shifokor qog‘ozi bilan. Farmatsevt ko‘p yordam beradi. So‘rang: 'Do I need a prescription for this?' 'Can I take this with other medicine?' 'Are there any side effects?'

scenes.title: Namuna: dorixonada suhbat
scenes.say_native: Namuna dorixona suhbatini o‘qing: mijoz o‘zi nima bezovta qilayotganini aytadi, farmatsevt savol beradi va retseptsiz dori taklif qiladi. E’tibor bering — farmatsevt ham savollar beradi: bu yaxshi belgi, demak u sizning niyatingizni to‘g‘ri tushunishni istaydi.
scenes.say: Good afternoon. I have a headache and a slight fever — do I need a prescription for something, or is there something over the counter? Pharmacist: How long have you had it? Since yesterday morning. Pharmacist: Any other symptoms — cough, nausea? A dry cough, that's all. Pharmacist: I'd suggest paracetamol — five hundred milligrams, two tablets three times a day, after meals. Pharmacist: And if the fever lasts more than two days, see a doctor. Can I drink alcohol? No, avoid alcohol while you take this.
scenes.say_uz: Xayrli kun. Boshim og‘riyapti, isitmam bir oz bor — retsept kerakmi yoki retseptsiz nimadir bormi? Farmatsevt: Qanchadan beri? Kemadan ertalabdan beri. Farmatsevt: Boshqa simptomlar bormi — yo‘tal, ko‘ngil aynishi? Faqat quruq yo‘tal. Farmatsevt: Parasetamol taklif qilaman — besh yuz milligram, ikki tablet kuniga uch marta, ovqatdan keyin. Farmatsevt: Isitma ikki kundan oshsa, shifokorga boring. Alkogol ichsam bo‘ladimi? Yo‘q, bu dorini ichganda alkogoldan saqlaning.

scenes.title: Doza ko‘rsatmasini takrorlang
board: 'One tablet twice a day, after meals'
scenes.say_native: Farmatsevt ko‘rsatmasini takrorlang. Vaziyat: sizga ikki turdagi dori berildi — parasetamol 500 mg, kuniga uch marta, ovqatdan keyin; va yo‘tal siropi, bir choy qoshiqda, kuniga ikki marta. Ikki dozani ham ovoz chiqarib aniq ayting va oxirida 'Is that right?' deb tasdiqlang. Yigirma besh soniya.
scenes.say: Repeat the pharmacist's instructions. You receive two medicines: paracetamol 500 milligrams, three times a day after meals; and cough syrup, one teaspoon twice a day. Say both aloud, clearly, and check: 'Is that right?' Twenty-five seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Farmatsevt ko‘rsatmasini takrorlang. Ikki dori: parasetamol 500 mg, kuniga uch marta, ovqatdan keyin; yo‘tal siropi, kuniga ikki marta bir choy qoshiqda. Ikkalasini ham ovoz chiqarib ayting: 'Is that right?' Yigirma besh soniya.

scenes.title: Tinglash 2: dorixonada — oshqozon
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi tinglash — dorixonada oshqozon og‘rig‘i. Jasur ovqatdan keyin uch kundan beri kuchli og‘riqdan shikoyat qiladi; farmatsevt simptomlar va xavfli belgilarni so‘raydi, keyin shifokorga borishni maslahat qiladi. Diqqat bilan tinglang — javoblar keyingi sahifada.
scenes.say: Jasur: I've had stomach pain after meals for three days — can I get something? Pharmacist: Sharp or dull? Dull, but strong — about a six. Pharmacist: Nausea, vomiting, blood? No — just pain and bloating. Pharmacist: I can give you something for the symptoms, but three days of post-meal pain — you should see a doctor. Jasur: It might just be spicy food. Pharmacist: Possibly, but see a doctor today, not next week. Jasur: All right — I'll make an appointment now.
scenes.say_uz: Jasur: Salom. Uch kundan beri ovqatdan keyin oshqozonim og‘riyapti — biror narsa berasizmi? Farmatsevt: Og‘riq o‘tkirmi yoki to‘mtoqmi? To‘mtoq, lekin kuchli — olti atrofida. Farmatsevt: Ko‘ngil aynishi, qayt qilish yoki najasda qon bormi? Yo‘q, faqat og‘riq va shish. Farmatsevt: Semptomlarni yengillashtirish uchun biror narsa bera olaman, lekin, ochiq aytaman, ovqatdan keyin uch kunlik og‘riq — shifokorga borishingiz kerak. Jasur: Balki achchiq ovqatdir. Farmatsevt: Mumkin, lekin imkon bo‘lsa bugunyoq shifokorga boring — kutmang. Jasur: Yaxshi. Hozir qabulga yozaman.

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari 2
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savol. Bir: Jasurning muammosi qanchadan beri davom etmoqda va qachon paydo bo‘ladi? Ikki: og‘riqning turi va o‘ndan necha ball? Uch: farmatsevt nima tavsiya qildi — nega? To‘rt: Jasur oxirida nima qilishga qaror qildi? Javoblarni ichingizda ayting.
scenes.say: Four questions. One: how long has Jasur had the problem, and when does it appear? Two: what type of pain and what score out of ten? Three: what did the pharmacist advise — and why? Four: what did Jasur decide to do in the end? Answers in your head.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt savol. Bir: qanchadan beri va qachon paydo bo‘ladi? Ikki: qanday og‘riq va necha ball? Uch: farmatsevt nima tavsiya qildi — nega? To‘rt: Jasur nima qaror qildi? Javoblarni ichingizda ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tinglash 2
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: uch kundan beri, ovqatdan keyin paydo bo‘ladi. Ikki: to‘mtoq, lekin kuchli — taxminan olti ball. Uch: farmatsevt alomatlarni yengillashtiradigan dori berishi mumkin, lekin uch kunlik doimiy og‘riq uchun shifokorga borishni qat’iy tavsiya qildi — dori tashxisni almashtira olmaydi. To‘rt: Jasur shubha qildi, lekin rozi bo‘lib, darhol qabulga yozilishga qaror qildi.
scenes.say: Answers. One: three days, after meals. Two: dull but strong — about six out of ten. Three: the pharmacist advised seeing a doctor rather than just masking symptoms — three days of post-meal pain needs a proper diagnosis, not just pills. Four: Jasur agreed and booked an appointment straight away.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Bir: uch kun, ovqatdan keyin. Ikki: to‘mtoq, lekin kuchli — olti atrofida. Uch: farmatsevt shifokorga borishni tavsiya qildi — simptomlarni yashirish emas, sababini aniqlash kerak. To‘rt: Jasur qabulga yozildi.

scenes.title: Allergiya va nojo‘ya ta’sirlar

examples.t: I'm allergic to penicillin — please avoid it.
examples.uz: Penitsillinga alergiyam bor — undan saqlaning, iltimos.

scenes.say_native: Allergiya savoli — shifokorning birinchi savollaridan biri: 'Are you allergic to anything?' Javobingiz tayyor bo‘lsin: 'I'm allergic to penicillin' — penitsillinga; 'I'm allergic to nuts' — yong‘oqqa; 'No known allergies' — ma’lum alergiya yo‘q. Nojo‘ya ta’sirlar: 'It may cause drowsiness' — uyquchanlik chaqirishi mumkin; 'Don't drive after taking this' — mashina haydamang; 'Stop and call us if you get a rash' — toshma chiqsa to‘xtating va qo‘ng‘iroq qiling. Bularni jim o‘tirmang — har doim so‘rang.
scenes.say: The allergy question comes early: 'Are you allergic to anything?' Have your answer ready — 'I'm allergic to penicillin', 'I'm allergic to peanuts', or 'No known allergies'. Side effects: 'It may cause drowsiness', 'Don't drive after taking this', 'Stop and call us if you get a rash'. Ask — every time.
scenes.say_uz: Allergiya savoli ertaroq keladi: 'Are you allergic to anything?' Javobingiz tayyor bo‘lsin — 'I'm allergic to penicillin', 'No known allergies'. Nojo‘ya ta’sirlar: 'It may cause drowsiness', 'Don't drive after taking this', 'Stop and call us if you get a rash'. Har doim so‘rang.

scenes.title: Shifokorga savollar: tushunganingizga ishonch

examples.t: How long until I start feeling better?

scenes.say_native: Qabuldan chiqishdan oldin uch savol bering: bir — 'What could this be?' — bu nima bo‘lishi mumkin; ikki — 'How long should I take it?' — qancha vaqt ichishim kerak; uch — 'When should I come back?' — qachon qaytib kelishim kerak. Yana bir yordamchi: 'How long until I start feeling better?' — qancha vaqtda yaxshilanaman. Bu savollar sizga nazorat hissini beradi va xatolarni kamaytiradi — qo‘rqqan savol yo‘q, faqat javobsiz simptom bor.
scenes.say: Three questions before you leave: 'What could this be?' 'How long should I take it?' 'When should I come back?' Plus: 'How long until I start feeling better?' No silly questions — only unasked ones. They give you control and prevent mistakes.
scenes.say_uz: Chiqishdan oldin uch savol: 'What could this be?' 'How long should I take it?' 'When should I come back?' Va: 'How long until I start feeling better?' Ahmoqona savol yo‘q — faqat so‘ralmagani bor. Nazorat va aniqlik beradi.

scenes.title: Favqulodda vaziyat: 999 yoki 112

examples.t: I'm having severe chest pain — please send an ambulance.
examples.uz: Ko‘kragimda kuchli og‘riq bor — tez yordam yuboring.

scenes.say_native: Ba’zi hollarda shifokor emas, tez yordam kerak: kuchli ko‘krak og‘rig‘i, nafas olish qiyinlashishi, ongni yo‘qotish, og‘izda qon. Telefon qiling: 'I'm having severe chest pain — please send an ambulance' — ko‘kragimda kuchli og‘riq bor, tez yordam yuboring. UKda 999, Yevropada va ko‘p mamlakatlarda 112. Manzilingizni, kim ekaningizni va aniq simptomni ayting. Bu dars tibbiy maslahat emas — shoshilinch alomatlarda shifokor yoki tez yordamga qo‘ng‘iroq qiling.
scenes.say: Some situations need an ambulance, not a clinic: severe chest pain, difficulty breathing, loss of consciousness, vomiting blood. Call: 'I'm having severe chest pain — please send an ambulance.' In the UK it's 999; in Europe and many countries, 112. Give your address and the exact symptom.
scenes.say_uz: Ba’zi holatlar klinikani emas, tez yordamni talab qiladi: kuchli ko‘krak og‘rig‘i, nafas olish qiyinligi, hushdan ketish, qon qayt qilish. Qo‘ng‘iroq qiling: 'I'm having severe chest pain — please send an ambulance.' UK — 999; ko‘p davlatda — 112. Manzil va simptomni ayting.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: stomach, ache, prescription

examples.t: I need a prescription for my stomach.

scenes.say_native: Uchta so‘zning talaffuzi o‘zgacha. 'Stomach' — 'STUM-uk', 'o' sakkizinchisi kabi o‘qilmaydi. 'Ache' — birgina bo‘g‘in: 'AYK'. 'Prescription' — 'prɪ-SKRIP-shn' — ruscha 'retsEPT' emas, inglizchasi stress ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda. 'Tablet' — 'TAB-let', 'syrup' — inglizchada 'SIR-up'. Shoshilmang — doza va simptom so‘zlari aniq talaffuz qilinsin.
scenes.say: Three pronunciations. 'Stomach' — 'STUM-uk', the o never says its name. 'Ache' — one syllable: 'AYK'. 'Prescription' — 'prɪ-SKRIP-shn', stress on the second syllable. 'Tablet' — 'TAB-let'. 'Syrup' — 'SIR-up'. Don't rush — dose words must be crystal clear.
scenes.say_uz: Uch talaffuz. 'Stomach' — 'STUM-uk'. 'Ache' — bir bo‘g‘in: 'AYK'. 'Prescription' — 'prɪ-SKRIP-shn'. 'Tablet' — 'TAB-let'. 'Syrup' — 'SIR-up'. Shoshilmang — doza so‘zlari aniq bo‘lsin.

scenes.title: 6 tipik xato: shifokor inglizchasida
board: 4 'I have got a cold since 2 days'
scenes.say_native: Olti xato. Bir: 'I have headache' — inglizchada artikl kerak: 'I have a headache'. Ikki: 'My head is paining' — 'My head hurts' yoki 'I have a headache'. Uch: 'I feel myself bad' — 'I feel bad' yoki 'I feel ill'. To‘rt: 'since 2 days' xato — 'for two days' yoki 'since Friday'. Besh: 'allergic with' emas — 'allergic to'. Oltinchi: 'make appointment' emas — 'make an appointment' — artikl kerak.
scenes.say: Six fixes. 'I have headache' needs an article: 'I have a headache.' 'My head is paining' becomes 'My head hurts'. 'I feel myself bad' becomes 'I feel bad'. 'Since two days' becomes 'for two days'. 'Allergic with' is 'allergic to'. And 'make an appointment' needs the 'an'.
scenes.say_uz: Olti tuzatish. 'I have headache' — artikl kerak: 'I have a headache.' 'My head is paining' — 'My head hurts'. 'I feel myself bad' — 'I feel bad'. 'Since two days' — 'for two days'. 'Allergic with' — 'allergic to'. 'Make an appointment' — 'an' kerak.

scenes.title: Xato → To‘g‘ri: artikl va fe’llar
board: ✓ 'My stomach has been hurting since this morning'
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato modelini tuzating. Birinchisi — artikl: o‘zbekchada 'bosh og‘rig‘im bor' da 'bir' so‘zi yo‘q, lekin inglizchada 'a headache' har doim artikl bilan keladi: a headache, a sore throat, a fever. Ikkkinchisi — zamon: 'My stomach is paining since morning' xato; inglizchada 'since' faqat present perfect bilan ishlaydi: 'My stomach has been hurting since this morning'.
scenes.say: Fix two patterns. One — articles: Uzbek has no equivalent, but English needs them: a headache, a sore throat, a fever. Two — tense: 'since' only works with the present perfect: 'My stomach has been hurting since this morning' — never with 'is paining'.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki shakl tuzating. Bir — artikl: inglizchada har doim kerak: a headache, a sore throat, a fever. Ikki — zamon: 'since' faqat present perfect bilan: 'My stomach has been hurting since this morning' — 'is paining' emas.

scenes.title: Xatolarni tuzating
scenes.say_native: Uchta xatoni to‘g‘rilang: 'I have sore throat' — 'I have a sore throat'. 'Allergic with penicillin' — 'allergic to penicillin'. 'Make appointment' — 'make an appointment'. Har birini ovoz chiqarib, to‘g‘ri shaklda ikki marta ayting — yigirma besh soniya.
scenes.say: Fix three: 'I have sore throat' — 'I have a sore throat.' 'Allergic with penicillin' — 'allergic to penicillin.' 'Make appointment' — 'make an appointment.' Aloud, twenty-five seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Uchtasini tuzating: 'I have sore throat' — 'I have a sore throat.' 'Allergic with penicillin' — 'allergic to penicillin.' 'Make appointment' — 'make an appointment.' Ovoz chiqarib — yigirma besh soniya.

scenes.title: Shifokor dialogini o‘ynang
scenes.say_native: Endi butun qabul sahnasini o‘ynang. Vaziyat: uch kundan beri bosh og‘rig‘i va yengil isitma; dorilar ichgansiz, lekin yordam bermadi. Shifokor savollar beradi: qachon boshlandi, qancha kuchli, allergiya bormi. Siz javob bering: davomiylik, kuch va allergiya haqida aytib, oxirida 'How long until I feel better?' deb so‘rang. Qirq soniya.
scenes.say: Act out the whole consultation. Scenario: a headache and slight fever for three days; you already took painkillers with no effect. The doctor asks when it started, how bad it is, and about allergies. Answer with duration, intensity and history; finish with 'How long until I feel better?' Forty seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Butun qabulni o‘ynang. Uch kundan beri bosh og‘rig‘i va yengil isitma; dorisi ichdingiz, yordam bermadi. Shifokor so‘raydi: qachon boshlandi, qancha kuchli, allergiya? Davomiylik, kuch va tarix bilan javob bering; oxirida 'How long until I feel better?' deb so‘rang. Qirq soniya.

scenes.title: Bugungi darsning xulosasi
scenes.say_native: Xulosa: simptomni sifat bilan ayting — 'a sharp pain in my chest'. Davomiylik — since nuqta, for davr; kuch — bir dan o‘n gacha shkala. Instruksiyalar — twice daily, after meals, finish the course. Dorixonada — over the counter yoki prescription, farmatsevt do‘stingiz. Va allergiyangizni har doim ochiq ayting.
scenes.say: In short: symptoms with adjectives — 'a sharp pain in my chest'. Duration — since or for; intensity — the one-to-ten scale. Instructions — twice daily, after meals, finish the course. Pharmacy — over the counter or prescription; the pharmacist is your friend. And always state your allergies.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa: simptom + sifat — 'a sharp pain in my chest'. Davomiylik — since/for; kuch — 1-10 shkala. Ko‘rsatmalar — twice daily, after meals, finish the course. Dorixona — over the counter yoki prescription; farmatsevt do‘stingiz. Allergiyangizni ayting.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Keyingi dars: Bank, pul va hujjatlar
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: shifokor bilan dialog yozing — uchta simptomni aniq ta’riflang (og‘riq turi, davomiyligi, kuchi), ikkita doza ko‘rsatmasi va bitta allergiya ma’lumotini qo‘shing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: inglizchada, simptomlar aniq, vaqt va kuch ko‘rsatilgan, dialog ovoz chiqarib o‘qilganda ikki daqiqadan oshmaydi. Keyingi darsda bank va hujjatlarni o‘rganamiz — hisob ochish, kartalar, tarjimalar va formalar. Omad tilayman!
scenes.say: Homework: write a doctor dialogue with three precisely described symptoms — type of pain, duration, intensity — plus two dosage instructions and one allergy note. Success criterion: fully in English, times and intensity included, read aloud in under two minutes. Next lesson: banking, money and documents. Good luck!
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: shifokor dialogini yozing — uch simptom (turi, davomiyligi, kuchi), ikki doza ko‘rsatmasi va bitta allergiya ma’lumoti. Mezon: inglizchada, vaqt va kuch bilan, ikki daqiqadan qisqa. Keyingi dars: bank, pul va hujjatlar. Omad tilayman!

quiz.q: What does 'I have a sore throat' mean?
options: My throat is inflamed and painful
quiz.why_uz: Sore — yallig‘langan, og‘riydigan; 'sore throat' — tomoq og‘rig‘i, eng keng tarqalgan shifokor shikoyatlaridan biri.

quiz.q: Which pair correctly uses since and for?
options: Since yesterday morning since two days
quiz.why_uz: Since + nuqta: since Monday, since yesterday. For + davr: for two days, for a week.

quiz.q: 'On a scale of one to ten, it's a seven.' What does this express?
options: How fast the pain comes and goes
quiz.why_uz: Bir dan o‘n gacha shkala og‘riq kuchini o‘lchaydi; o‘n — chidab bo‘lmas, bir — deyarli his qilinmas.

options: A headache that comes and goes with heartbeat rhythm
A headache behind the eyes only
quiz.why_uz: Throbbing — yurak urishi bilan urib og‘rish; migren va sinusitda ko‘p uchraydi.

quiz.q: How do you politely ask the GP for a visit?
options: 'I'd like to make an appointment, please.'
quiz.why_uz: 'I'd like to make an appointment' — resepsiondagi eng to‘g‘ri va muloyim ibora.

quiz.q: What does 'finish the full course' mean?
options: Complete all the doses even if you feel better
Take the medicine only on weekends
quiz.why_uz: Antibiotik kursni to‘liq tugatish — infeksiya qaytmasligi va chidamlilik rivojlanmasligi uchun eng muhim qoida.

options: You can buy it without a prescription
quiz.why_uz: Over the counter — retseptsiz sotiladigan dorilar; prescription-only — retsept talab qiladi.

quiz.q: How should you answer 'Are you allergic to anything?'
quiz.why_uz: Allergiya haqida aniq javob bering — 'I'm allergic to…' yoki 'No known allergies'; shifokor tashxisi uchun eng muhim ma’lumot.

options: I have headache since two days.
My stomach is paining since morning.
I have a headache for two days.
quiz.why_uz: Artikl + for + davr: 'I have a headache for two days'. Qolgan uchasi artikl, zamon va fe’l xatolari.

quiz.q: When should you call 999 or 112 instead of a GP?
options: For a mild cough and runny nose
For severe chest pain or difficulty breathing
To ask for a repeat prescription
quiz.why_uz: Ko‘krak og‘rig‘i va nafas olish qiyinlashishi — shoshilinch: 999 (UK) yoki 112 (ko‘p mamlakatlar).
